main.description: A directed DIACHRONIC influence 縁 between two public historical nodes (figure/document/event/tradition) — the channel across which an idea/text/practice flowed forward in time and deformed the receiver's metric (junkawasaki.com 'spirit is information'). tsumugi diachronic extension, ADR-2606061500. strain.description: ε — metric deformation the receiver underwent (blog strain tensor magnitude) in milli-units (×1000 of [0,1])

thermoLength.description: L — thermodynamic length of the receiver's reframing (W_diss ≥ L²/2τ) in milli-units; cost of integrating the influence

source.description: provenance of the CLAIM (never asserts truth of the tradition, only that the influence is documented; N3)
